action.objective: Verify dxc5, capturing the black rook, winning heavy material with the extra rook and passed pawns.
action.rationale: Broad search (depth 3, exact +1441) prefers d4c5, which captures Black's rook on c5 with the d4 pawn. The prior commit Bxb4 allowed Rc8-c5, and now the rook can be taken by pawn. d4c5 has the best exact evidence; verify this single candidate with the reserved budget to confirm safety (no mate-in-one, no tactical refutation) and reach deeper depth.
